intro_html: Tortilla soup flavor, meal prep convenience, and a bowl that keeps the grocery bill low. Black beans and corn round it out so you get plenty of protein and a filling meal that barely dents the grocery bill. One batch makes 14 servings.
cost_closing_html: About $3.80 a bowl (at everyday cost) for a high-protein dinner that beats takeout on price and macros.
portion_html: Each of the 14 servings comes in around 57g protein for about 559 calories, at roughly $2.07 a bowl.
upsell_html: Cheap, cozy, and ready to go, this is meal prep that actually makes you smile. Members get every recipe in the Meal Prep section, plus the full library of money lessons and tools, all for $1 a month.
shop_smart: Canned black beans and corn are pantry-cheap and do a lot of the flavor and filling work here.
Buy the chicken breast in bulk to keep every bowl well under budget.
Store-brand crushed tomatoes cook down just as well as the name brand for less money.
make_it: Add the chicken breast and the can of crushed tomatoes to the crock.
Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours until the chicken is tender.
Shred the chicken, then stir in the black beans and corn.
Let it heat through for another 15 to 20 minutes.
Cook your rice while the pot finishes.
Spoon over rice and finish each bowl with a little cheddar.
